history.text: The Kingdom of Kush ruled from Napata and later Meroe, briefly governing Egypt.
Christian Nubian kingdoms held the Nile valley for centuries.
The Mahdist state ruled until the Anglo-Egyptian reconquest.
South Sudan seceded, taking most oil production.
Omar al-Bashir was removed after months of protest.

worthSeeing.title: Pyramids of Meroe:
worthSeeing.text: More pyramids than in Egypt, on the desert plateau, a UNESCO site.

worthSeeing.title: Jebel Barkal:
worthSeeing.text: A sacred mountain and Napatan temple complex, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Nile confluence:
worthSeeing.text: The meeting of the Blue and White Nile at Khartoum.
